name: Publish Skills

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.skills/**'
      - 'skill.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Force re-publish all skills'
        required: false
        default: 'false'

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install ClawHub CLI
        run: |
          curl -sSL https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/releases/latest/download/clawhub-linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv clawhub /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Publish changed skills
        env:
          CLAWHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          clawhub login --token "$CLAWHUB_TOKEN"

          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" && "${{ github.event.inputs.force }}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Force re-publish all skills"
            for skill_dir in .skills/*/; do
              skill=$(basename "$skill_dir")
              echo "Publishing skill: $skill"
              clawhub publish "$skill_dir" --accept-license-terms
            done
          else
            echo "Detecting changed skills"
            changed_files=$(git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.before }} ${{ github.sha }})
            skills_changed=()
            while read -r file; do
              if [[ "$file" == .skills/* ]]; then
                skill=$(basename "$(dirname "$file")")
                if [[ ! " ${skills_changed[*]} " =~ " $skill " ]]; then
                  skills_changed+=("$skill")
                fi
              fi
            done <<< "$changed_files"
            if [[ ${#skills_changed[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
              echo "No skill changes detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            for skill in "${skills_changed[@]}"; do
              echo "Publishing skill: $skill"
              clawhub publish ".skills/$skill" --accept-license-terms
            done
          fi
